# Runway

> Runway is a FIRE (Financial Independence, Retire Early) planner for iPhone and iPad, built for Norway first. It turns a person's finances into one number, the age they could stop working, using Norway's real tax rules: formuesskatt (wealth tax), the ASK account's capital-first withdrawals, the skjermingsfradrag, NAV and IPS pensions, and the utflyttingsskatt (exit tax) owed on leaving. It also prices retiring abroad: 17 destination countries are modelled with 2026 figures, plus a generic baseline for anywhere else. Everything is computed on-device with no account and no bank logins. Made by Ludyem AS. On the App Store from August 25, 2026; a free TestFlight beta is open before then.

Key facts:
- The freedom age and freedom number are free forever; Runway never paywalls "when can I stop working?". A Pro tier adds year-by-year depth, stress tests, scenario comparison, and solvers.
- Platform: iOS 26 or later, iPhone and iPad. English and Norwegian Bokmål.
- Privacy: no account, no bank connections; figures never leave the device.
- All figures are income-year-stamped estimates (2026) from public sources, not financial or tax advice.

- [IPS vs ASK](https://runwayfire.com/blog/ips-vs-ask-norway/): the 2026 cap rise, the age-62 lock, which to fill first
- [Folketrygden and FIRE](https://runwayfire.com/blog/state-pension-early-retirement-norway/): the pension bridge that shrinks your number
- [Exit tax when leaving Norway](https://runwayfire.com/blog/exit-tax-leaving-norway/): what emigrating costs on unrealised gains
- [FIRE calculators for retiring abroad](https://runwayfire.com/blog/fire-calculator-retire-abroad/): tool comparison for cross-border moves
- [FIRE apps for iPhone](https://runwayfire.com/blog/fire-apps-iphone/): the native iOS field compared
